content.text: In regions where conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-one-afternoon-fast|Payment Gateways]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, digital creators face significant obstacles in setting up online stores. The lack of infrastructure to support [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-first-principles-definitive-3|COREMERCH guide to crypto]] payments often leaves these creators locked out of their markets. With COREMERCH's stacks, specifically Stack 01 and Stack 02, you gain the ability to establish a fully operational digital store without reliance on traditional payment channels. This guide focuses on utilizing [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/supabase-order-database-digital-stores-step-step-deployment-15|supabase]] as your order database, ensuring you are equipped to launch your store efficiently and effectively, bypassing the limitations set by restrictive platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often impose barriers that restrict access to digital commerce for many creators. COREMERCH's infrastructure offers a solution that empowers digital creators by providing complete ownership over their commerce setup. Stack 01 leverages GitHub Pages and Apps Script, while Stack 02 utilizes Cloudflare Pages and Workers, both of which integrate seamlessly with NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This architecture is designed with resilience in mind, ensuring that even in the face of financial isolation, you can maintain full control over your store and customer data. By choosing COREMERCH, you are not just adopting a workaround; you are establishing a robust, sovereign commerce ecosystem.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your store, gather the essential components needed for successful setup. First, ensure you have a GitHub account to utilize GitHub Pages for hosting your storefront. Next, familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script, as it will handle the backend logic of your store. Additionally, create a NOWPayments account to enable cryptocurrency payment processing. An understanding of Supabase as your order database will also be crucial for managing transactions. Finally, prepare your digital products—whether they are ebooks, courses, or software—so they are ready for upload upon deployment. With these elements in place, you will be equipped to launch your store efficiently.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline effectively, begin by configuring NOWPayments within your chosen stack. This integration allows for automatic on-chain payment verification, enabling seamless transactions without the need for KYC. Next, establish your order database using Supabase, which will store transaction details and customer information securely. For product delivery, utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for hosting your digital files, ensuring they are easily accessible after purchase. This pipeline not only facilitates instant product delivery but also guarantees that you retain full ownership and control over your data. Testing this setup in a staging environment before going live is crucial to ensure everything operates smoothly.
Own your infrastructure and eliminate dependency on restrictive platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, it's time to go live. Deploy your GitHub Pages site and ensure that your Apps Script is functioning correctly. After confirming that everything is operational, promote your store to your audience. When a customer makes a purchase, the NOWPayments integration will process their payment, followed by an automatic webhook that confirms the transaction on-chain. This confirmation triggers the delivery of the product to the customer via your selected method. As this is your first transaction, monitor the process closely to identify any potential issues and to ensure the customer experience is seamless. This step marks your transition from setup to active commerce.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing your initial transactions, focus on scaling your digital store. Begin by analyzing transaction data stored in Supabase to understand customer behavior and product performance. This analysis will guide your decisions on expanding product offerings and marketing efforts. Consider integrating additional features such as email marketing through your infrastructure to keep customers engaged. With Stack 02, you can load up to five products, allowing for greater flexibility as you scale. As you grow, continue to optimize your cloud hosting and backend logic to accommodate increased traffic and transactions without compromising performance. This proactive approach will ensure your store remains robust and responsive.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, you can utilize COREMERCH's infrastructure stacks. Stack 01 allows you to deploy a store using GitHub Pages and Apps Script, enabling you to accept payments via NOWPayments without incurring platform fees. This setup ensures you retain control over your digital products and customer data, offering a sustainable solution for creators in restricted regions.
Seamless crypto payment processing with immediate product delivery.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're exploring options for hosting your digital store, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. This stack provides an end-to-end tested solution, ensuring you can scale effectively. You can also check out more resources at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a GitHub account for hosting your store. 2. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script for backend logic. 3. Set up a NOWPayments account for crypto transactions. 4. Configure Supabase as your order database. 5. Prepare your digital products for upload. 6. Deploy your GitHub Pages site and test the entire pipeline. 7. Promote your store and begin processing transactions.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept crypto payments for my digital store?

You can accept crypto payments by integrating NOWPayments into your store setup. This allows customers to pay using over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring a wide range of options without KYC requirements.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages and Apps Script for deployment, taking 4-6 hours. Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages and Workers, deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with additional features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages, depending on your stack choice. Each offers unique benefits and can integrate with payment solutions like NOWPayments.
What kind of support is available after deploying with COREMERCH?
COREMERCH provides 30-day support after deployment, ensuring you have assistance as you navigate any challenges or questions regarding your store's operation and maintenance.
How long does it take to set up my digital store?
Setting up your digital store can take as little as 4-6 hours with Stack 01. Stack 02 is deployed in 48 hours, providing a quick pathway to launching your online commerce.
